report_name: Dairy Queen Operator Fourteen Foods Discloses Data Breach

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: An unauthorized party accessed the Fourteen Foods corporate computer environment, suggesting the use of compromised but valid credentials.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Local System
attack_patterns.description: The unauthorized party copied certain files containing sensitive personal information, including names and Social Security numbers, from the company's network.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Sensitive files containing personal information were exfiltrated from the Fourteen Foods network to an attacker-controlled location.

campaigns.name: February 2026 Fourteen Foods Data Breach
campaigns.description: A network intrusion campaign in February 2026 targeting Fourteen Foods, resulting in the exfiltration of sensitive personal information, including names and Social Security numbers. The breach was detected on February 23, 2026, but impacted individuals were not notified until October 2026.

identities.name: Fourteen Foods
identities.description: A major franchisee of Dairy Queen Grill & Chill restaurants that suffered a data breach in February 2026, exposing sensitive personal information of an undisclosed number of individuals.

identities.name: Dairy Queen Grill & Chill
identities.description: Restaurant brand operated by Fourteen Foods, the primary victim of the data breach.

indicators.name: Anomalous Egress Data Transfer
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Egress Data Transfer
id: 2b8c1f9a-7d3e-4b0c-8a1d-9f6e5c4b3a2e
status: experimental
description: Detects unusually large data transfers from internal servers to external destinations, which could indicate data exfiltration.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-26
references:
  - https://www.claimdepot.com/data-breach/fourteen-foods-2026
tags:
  - attack.t1041
level: medium
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Initiated: true
    DataTotal|gt: 100000000 # Adjust threshold based on baseline
  filter_known_destinations:
    DestinationHostname|endswith:
      - '.microsoft.com'
      - '.windowsupdate.com'
      - '.google.com'
      - '.aws.amazon.com'
  condition: selection and not filter_known_destinations
indicators.description: Detects large or unusual data transfers from internal servers to external IP addresses, which could be indicative of data exfiltration as seen in the Fourteen Foods breach.
